implementation: skill 0.2.0; optional level_analysis; legacy arithmetic assessment retained

rules: Keep source, symbol/feed/price basis, timeframe, origin, confirmation and availability separate. Supplied levels are unverified annotations until evidence is checked.

Ordinary profile requires explicit master, extreme, context reference and context availability; validate one preleg route, strict close cover and selected exact construction. Arithmetic consistency does not independently certify analyst context or highest valid timeframe.
Three-standard-bars route: at least three ordered distinct known bars of standard range, directional toward the pivot, ending by the master. Intervening noise remains contextual.

Length alternative: explicitly supplied start/end, ATR snapshot bar and positive threshold. Engineering distance is start open to end directional extreme; ATR is the baseline before atr_bar_id. Never silently require both routes.
First closed bar strictly across master extreme confirms cover; first two are timely, later is late without erasing the level. Extreme must belong to the preleg-start through cover interval.
Wick-to-body uses selected extreme candle; half-ATR uses frozen prior-bar ATR at that extreme. No method union, price rounding, arbitrary tolerance or silent timeframe reassignment.
Zero-width wick requires construction review. Unusual width relative to ATR is a review flag, not an invented numerical rejection threshold.
Order nodes, exceptional/self-cover pivots and dynamic trendlines need separate evidence and remain outside automated structural validation.
Explicit left/right windows 1..20; default is no discovery. Test profile is 2/2, not a calibrated trading parameter.
Strict low below or high above every neighboring bar; equal extrema are unresolved plateaus. Candidate becomes available only after all right-side bars close and dependencies are available.
Swing geometry is not a Trex pivot, a structural master, an inferred institution/order pool or an entry signal. Output always needs structural review unless separate ordinary evidence is supplied.
No backdating availability to extreme candle; no selection using future prices.
Touch means observed OHLC range intersects zone; consecutive touching full bars are one descriptive episode. Formation bars are excluded; partial availability is explicitly ambiguous.

Closed price beyond far edge ends active original role for this conservative selection profile; wick penetration or equality does not. This close-through flag is not the strict three-bar breakout model.
Original identity/timeframe remain; no automatic opposite role or restoration after a return. New role needs new context and identity/version.
Overlapping/touching intervals are identity groups, not merged price bounds or multiple independent confirmations. Connected chains are disclosed without widening an original zone.
Touch counts, age, departure speed/size, round numbers, volume source and higher timeframe are review descriptors, not automatic scores or probability decay. Forex volume is feed-specific.
Use opposing original-role levels ahead in direction. Long uses resistance near/lower edge; short uses support near/upper edge. Exact zone bounds persist.
Scenario pool freezes at scenario-start bar open; anchor must already be known and not broken. A map without scenario uses selection-bar availability and last close.
Nearest independent obstacle comes first, including unreviewed candidates. Never skip it to select a farther validated target or to improve reward/risk.
Overlapping anchor components extending into the path and zones containing reference require zone review; do not label same area an independent target.
Levels with a broken original role before freeze are excluded but retained in audit. Levels discovered after freeze cannot be backfilled into that scenario.
Cross-timeframe/source comparisons require properly closed aligned evidence; this single-series helper cannot clear higher-timeframe obstacles or verify another feed.
No known target means no known target; no invented projection, automatic ATR multiplier or confidence.
Track selected frozen target from scenario-start through selection close. If reached before confirmation, the original scenario needs reassessment. Do not silently roll to a farther target.
Price gap beyond zone consumes room for this profile but does not prove a traded touch, order execution or fill. OHLC does not reveal exact intrabar order.
Historical scenario invalidation takes priority; target review must not overwrite invalidated status or create events after termination.

Legacy template status remains geometric. When level_analysis is requested, continuation additionally requires ordinary anchor consistency, conditional nearest target, matching anchor/direction/start/current selection/target IDs. It still requires higher timeframe, entry and risk review.

Projected targets from Excel trade B10 (3/7 trigger ATR or structure-minus-trigger ATR) remain hypotheses. Anchor price, safety offset, timeframe alignment and empirical validation are unresolved; never assert high reversal probability or guaranteed range.
Risk/reward cannot be inferred from level distance alone; entry/stop/execution costs and instrument specifications are required. No trading orders or sizing.

engineering_assumptions: start-open to end-extreme displacement measurement with explicit threshold
freeze at scenario start and nearest obstacle veto
